title: Millaisia and minkälaisia: describing several things
focus: Use millaisia or minkälaisia to ask for qualities of the members of an ordinary plural group: Millaisia kirjat ovat? Millaisia talot ovat? — Talot ovat pieniä.
targetSkills: Millaisia and minkälaisia: describing several things
prerequisiteSkills: Millainen and minkälainen: describing one person or thing

exercises.prompt: Choose the question meaning “What are the houses like?”
exercises.explanation: Plural means more than one in this grammatical pattern. The partitive is a word form used here for an amount, an action's object, or a substance or group description. Use millaisia or minkälaisia to ask for qualities of the members of an ordinary plural group: Millaisia kirjat ovat? (“What are the books like?”). The subject noun has its plural basic form. The complete question means “What are the houses like”.
requiredSkills: Millaisia and minkälaisia: describing several things
exercises.targetSkill: Millaisia and minkälaisia: describing several things
